title: Did COVID-19 Actually Come From a Lab? Two Top Scientists Debate Its Origins
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
There's nothing Republicans love to do more than:

  1. [Rehash](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cdx85vkk0gko) the COVID-19 pandemic

  2. [Pretend](https://www.washingtonpost.com/health/2024/06/03/fauci-covid-house-testimony-lab-leak/) to know what they're talking about

In the last few weeks, Senate Republicans have been able to do both of these,
as they [relentlessly](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/31/us-senates-
fauci-hearing-renews-covid-origin-debate-but-reveals-little) claim that the
COVID-19 virus must have come from a lab in China, despite all the scientific
[evidence](https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-62307383) saying
otherwise. Nevertheless, the GOP's messaging has proved to be quite
convincing, with the [majority](https://yougov.com/en-
us/articles/45389-americans-believe-covid-origin-lab) of Americans believing
COVID-19 came from a lab.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

But here at **Zeteo** , we believe in cutting through the noise, listening to
the experts, and hearing out _reasonable_ people (aka, not Senator Rand Paul).

That's why in this 'Mehdi Unfiltered' segment, **Mehdi** moderates a very
factual and insightful debate on the lab leak theory. Leading virologist and
Save America Movement science chair **Dr. Angela Rasmussen**
[argues](https://zeteo.com/p/tulsi-trump-war-on-fauci-lab-
leak?utm_source=publication-search) that COVID-19 likely came from zoonotic -
or natural - origins, not a lab, while **Dr. Ashish Jha,** who was President
Biden's COVID-19 response coordinator,
[argues](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/02/politics/video/former-white-house-
covid-19-response-coordinator-dr-ashish-jha-dana-bash-it-was-probably-a-lab-
leak) that COVID-19, in his view, likely came from a Chinese laboratory.

Here are some of the key questions Mehdi asks:

  * Why Jha changed his mind on COVID-19 origins and now supports the lab leak theory

  * Why Rasmussen's own research supports zoonotic origins

  * Whether Republicans have overstated the merits of the lab leak theory

  * Their reactions to recent GOP [misinformation](https://health.yahoo.com/your-body/womens-health/pregnancy-fertility/articles/fact-check-studies-not-show-054858979.html) around the COVID-19 vaccine and miscarriages

  * How prepared - or _unprepared_ - the U.S. is for another pandemic
